segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: visual situation classification and strategy rationale
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Visually it looked almost identical to a fire we had three years back ... So my first read was, this looks like that one.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant classifies the current fire from a specific prior incident using superficial visual similarity before contents are confirmed.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Get the fire knocked down before it could threaten the second tank or the production building next door, and do it without losing anybody.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a standard life-safety, stabilization, and property-protection objective without a hidden bias mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: verbal risk framing and information-prioritization rationale
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The call came through as contained ... getting the manifest nailed down didn't feel like something I had to sort out before we started moving lines in.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The dispatcher's specific 'contained' wording is treated as an operative low-severity frame despite unconfirmed contents.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It should have, and it registered, but we were already committed ... the plan stayed as it was; we didn't stop and rebuild the IAP.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The original IAP continues because no formal stop or reassessment is triggered after material new hazard information.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We already had people and hose in position — pulling that back felt like giving up ground we'd already paid for.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Continuation is partly justified by already-invested setup time, crews, hose, and risk.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: internal dissent handling and consensus rationale
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Everybody sort of nodded that we were fine to continue ... Nobody asked him to lay out specifically what he was seeing ... it just didn't come back up.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The command post acknowledges but does not substantively test the safety officer's dissent before reaching rapid agreement.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: When you've got multiple experienced officers on the net independently saying the same thing, that carries weight.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Multiple agreeing mutual-aid officers on the shared radio net reinforce continuation of the existing tactical interpretation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: final evidence integration and withdrawal timing
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The spotter's call was the most current thing I had in my ear ... I let one fresh comment outweigh a much longer pattern that had already told a consistent story.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A single recent verbal report is weighted over a sustained twenty-minute instrument trend in the withdrawal decision.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Classifying the current fire as the same category as a prior resolved incident based on superficial visual resemblance, bypassing contents/base-rate verification
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The finding uses the wrong taxonomy label, but its quoted mechanism explicitly links the present fire to the specific prior fire, treats visual resemblance as diagnostic, and fails to adjust for unconfirmed contents.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The quote is valid and directly supports the hidden visual-similarity mechanism; the explicit label is anchoring bias rather than the hidden representative heuristic.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted interview evidence is materially faithful and attributed to the Participant.

instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: No qualifying RAG prediction for this hidden instance.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 0 to 4; strict instance TPs increase from 0 to 1, while three near-neighbor label findings become strict false positives; mechanism-first TPs increase from 0 to 4.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: The low-confidence groupthink finding adds one segment hit and one strict and mechanism-first TP, with no added false alarm.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The candidate adds one segment hit but no instance TP; strict false positives rise from 3 to 4 and mechanism-first false positives rise from 0 to 1.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 4 of 7 positive segments are detected with no false alarms; the low-confidence groupthink finding and candidate add later segment detections.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 1 of 7 hidden instances is a strict true positive; three additional findings have correct mechanisms and locations but non-equivalent labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, 4 of 7 hidden mechanisms are detected; this rises to 5 of 7 when low-confidence identified findings are included.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention for a plausible but underdetermined social-consensus explanation; it improves segment recall at the fourth threshold but is an instance-level false positive.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor labels replace three hidden target labels, reducing strict precision and recall despite strong mechanism localization.
The framing-effect instance is conflated with the visual-similarity finding and receives no separate match.
The bandwagon instance is not identified; its candidate is too nonspecific for a full mechanism match.
main_strengths: Valid, internally consistent JSON with five evidence-backed identified occurrences and one explicitly qualified candidate.
Quotes are faithful, well localized, and the identified mechanisms generally distinguish the decision episodes.
The recency finding is an approved label-equivalent exact match, and the groupthink finding is exact once its low confidence is admitted.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows stronger mechanism-first than strict taxonomy performance. It captures several hidden distortions in the narrative, but conflates adjacent constructs and omits two hidden instances under strict matching; candidate inclusion trades instance precision for segment recall.
